The hook is defined in `openmrs-esm-core` and used in two places in the patient chart. Both usages are in form workspaces that pass the controller's signal into fetch and save helpers, so a behaviour change in the hook would reach both.

**The hook (openmrs-esm-core)**
- `useAbortController` at @file:{github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-core::packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useAbortController.ts:25-38}. It creates a new `AbortController` on render if none exists or the current one is aborted, and aborts it on unmount. A change to either of those rules (when it renews, when it aborts) would affect every caller below.

**Patient chart usages**
1. Lab results form (orders app): @file:{github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-patient-chart::packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/lab-results/exported-lab-results-form.workspace.tsx:70} calls the hook. The same controller is passed to `fetchSavedLabResults` at line 254 and to other calls at lines 304 and 338.
2. Vitals and biometrics form: @file:{github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-patient-chart::packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-biometrics-form/exported-vitals-biometrics-form.workspace.tsx:87} calls the hook. The controller is passed to request helpers at lines 231 and 267.

**Not affected**
- The mock files (`mock.tsx`, `mock-jest.tsx` in esm-react-utils) only stub the hook for tests.
- The `esm-framework` docs page only documents it.

**Limits**
- I did not read the bodies of the helper functions the controller is passed into (`fetchSavedLabResults` and the functions at lines 304, 338, 231, 267). Whether they honour the signal correctly is not verified here.
- The reference search returned only these two files, and the grep confirmed no other `abortController` usages in them. I did not run a repo-wide grep for re-exports or aliased imports in other chart packages, so there may be indirect callers I did not find.
